extensions.name: coord
extensions.description: Default coordination-v0 inbox, grants and scope controls. Requires protected operational state and resolved principals; missing support is visible and fails closed. No terminal typing or replay.

extensions.name: herdr
extensions.description: Terminals in herdr-core (vqro-herdr): the default backend. Reaches herdr-core with $VQRO_HERDR or `hc connect`.

extensions.name: tmux
extensions.description: Terminals in a vqro-owned tmux server that survives provider/core restarts; stop explicitly with tmux.server.stop. Never your own tmux sessions. Off by default.

extensions.name: tmux-server
extensions.description: Independent status and confirmed stop for the vqro-owned tmux server, even when its provider is disabled. No menu while no server exists.

extensions.name: retention
extensions.description: Forgets finished terminals 60 s after no layout shows them (undo within that brings them back; keeps the newest 64 never-shown). Off keeps every finished terminal.

extensions.name: logs
extensions.description: In-app viewer for extension logs (core-host files); Settings offers it as View log.

extensions.name: links
extensions.description: Opens what you Ctrl-click in a terminal: URLs in the browser, files in an editor split. Off: links do nothing.
